purpose: Teach: 熟語/官能/固体/開校/国体/農耕/高分子/感嘆

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員教育で熟語の理解力を強化しろ
lines.en: I want our company to strengthen employees' understanding of idioms and turns of phrase.
lines.style: Crisp, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. Measured pace. Each clause lands with equal weight. No softening—this is a directive, not a request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の官能評価を社内で導入します
lines.en: Understood. I'll introduce sensory evaluation assessments for our products across the company.
lines.style: Attentive, taking mental notes. Slight nod mid-sentence. Steady, professional tone. Neither rushed nor hesitant—the cadence of someone confirming they've absorbed the instruction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、固体物流の効率化を進めろ
lines.en: And push forward on streamlining our logistics operations for solid goods.
lines.style: Firm, chained logically to the first point. Lean forward slightly. Brief pause before the final clause for emphasis. Tone doesn't soften—another directive in sequence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内研修施設の開校を計画します
lines.en: Understood. We'll plan the opening of an in-house training facility.
lines.style: Methodical, jotting mental notes. Brief pause between clauses—checking the list. Warm undertone beneath the professional surface. Reliable, not robotic.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 国体大会へのスポンサーも検討しろ
lines.en: Consider sponsoring the National Athletic Games as well.
lines.style: As well—added almost as an afterthought, but still weighted with importance. Slight pause before the final phrase. Tone remains steady, authoritative. No rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。農耕事業者向け新商品を企画します
lines.en: Understood. We'll develop new products aimed at agricultural businesses.
lines.style: Intake of breath—acknowledging the growing list. Calm, capable tone. Slight widening of responsibility in his voice but no strain. The assurance of someone who can hold multiple priorities.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、高分子素材の研究開発を強化しろ
lines.en: And strengthen our research and development in polymer materials.
lines.style: Final directive in the sequence. Slight emphasis on strengthen—linking back to the first point thematically. Composed, unhurried. The weight of expectation clear but not aggressive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の感嘆を呼ぶ新製品を作ります
lines.en: Understood. I'll create products that capture market admiration and attention.
lines.style: Longer breath here—the scope has expanded. Still composed, but there's a quiet intensity underneath. Less routine-sounding than the previous responses. This is the close—the final commitment.
